# Zuri Platform — UI Component Inventory

**Version:** 1.3
**Date:** 2026-04-17
**Total:** 39 components — all implemented (0 stubs)

> **v1.1 changes (PR #12 + PR #13):**
> - Topbar redesigned — bell removed, theme/Settings/Logout consolidated into user-avatar Dropdown, notification count rendered as avatar badge
> - Sidebar — bottom Settings/Logout removed (now in user Dropdown)
> - **NEW** `BottomNav` (mobile primary nav, 5 tabs)
> - **NEW** `Dropdown` (reusable menu primitive)
> - POS Mobile `CartDrawer` rewritten from bottom sheet to right-side slide-out
> - **NEW** `RadialMenu` (FAB with fan-out satellites on POS Mobile)
>
> **v1.2 changes (PR #14 — ADR-079 v2):**
> - Topbar is CSS-hidden below `md`; desktop unchanged
> - BottomNav grows from 5 → 6 items and now embeds Profile + More bottom sheets (tenant header, theme, TH/EN, Settings, Sign out, secondary modules)
> - `RadialMenu` supports `href` actions + `hideOnDesktop` + `aboveBottomNav` props; used by `(dashboard)/layout.jsx` as a contextual module sub-nav on mobile
>
> **v1.3 changes (PR #15 — ADR-079 v3):**
> - BottomNav grows to 7 items — a centre **combo FAB** (top half Plus / bottom half Bot) replaces the free-floating `AiFab` on mobile. Tap = Radial, drag up = Radial, drag down = Chat.
> - `RadialMenu` adds controlled-open state (`open`, `onOpenChange`, `hideTrigger`) and a new `anchor="bc"` mode for symmetric centre-anchored arcs.
> - `AiFab` CSS-hidden below `md`; `AiChatPopup` becomes a responsive mobile bottom sheet.
> - The contextual RadialMenu on mobile is now owned by `BottomNav` (was `(dashboard)/layout.jsx`).

| `CartDrawer` | Right-side slide-out cart + floating cart FAB (top-right) with item-count badge. Auto-opens on first add, backdrop tap closes, checkout footer fires `onCheckout`. | `cart`, `updateCartItem`, `removeFromCart`, `total`, `onCheckout` | ~215 | `/pos/mobile` |
| `RadialMenu` | FAB with satellites fanned in a quarter- or 140° arc; supports `href` (renders `<Link>`) or `onClick` actions. `hideOnDesktop` + `aboveBottomNav` for dashboard shell reuse. `anchor: 'br' \| 'bl' \| 'bc'`. Optional controlled state (`open` / `onOpenChange` / `hideTrigger`) so an external button (e.g. BottomNav combo) can drive it. Satellite `active` tints orange. | `actions`, `anchor`, `radius`, `hideOnDesktop`, `aboveBottomNav`, `open`, `onOpenChange`, `hideTrigger` | ~175 | `/pos/mobile`, `BottomNav` (contextual module sub-nav via combo button) |
| `PaymentFlow` | Payment modal — QR/CASH/CARD + slip upload | `total`, `member`, `orderType`, `onConfirm` | ~400 | `/pos/mobile` |
| `ReceiptModal` | Receipt preview / print | `order`, `onClose` | ~220 | `/pos/mobile` |
